environment.description: ECS Fargate task running amazonlinux:2 base image with ImageMagick 6.9.12 installed. Container runs as root. Task role has s3:GetObject/PutObject on the conversion bucket. Service is behind an internal NLB (TCP passthrough, no inspection). No syscall filtering configured. Container filesystem is writable. The ECS task definition uses default Docker seccomp (which allows execve, clone, etc.).
